name: @mframework/auth-email-domains
description: Sign-up email domains for M Framework's auth layer: block domains, or allow only some. A sandboxed auth plugin — it runs in its own locked-down process and only sees the part of an email after the @.

integration.name: Sign-up email domains
integration.description: Only let people sign up with email addresses from domains you choose, or block domains you don't want.

mode.label: Mode
mode.help: Block: refuse sign-ups from the domains below. Allow: accept sign-ups only from the domains below.

domains.label: Domains
domains.help: For example example.com, or *.example.com for its subdomains. An empty list restricts nothing.

message.label: Message shown when a sign-up is refused
message.default: Sign-ups with this email address aren't allowed.

scripts.build: echo 'auth-email-domains is consumed from source (module.ts); no build step' && exit 0

author: Meeovi Labs
